title: Plaid footer
description: A deep navy footer with 40px top corners: a large icon mark on the left and up to four columns of link groups (mint-white bold headings, white 16px links) that wrap into a second row, then social icons and a legal row with the copyright, a region picker with a pin and a privacy-choices link with a small toggle badge. Two columns on phones.
notes: set `overlap` when it follows plaid-contact: it then pulls up 2.5rem so its rounded corners sit over the gradient
the surface is the foreground colour deepened with primary in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
name: plaid-footer

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon: LucideIcon; }
props.description: the mark at the top left

props.name: groups
props.description: the link groups: four to a row on desktop, two on phones

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links, each with its icon

props.name: privacy
props.description: the privacy-choices link with its toggle badge

props.name: overlap
props.description: pull up over the band before it, so the rounded corners show that band
